module: MCP tools for the interface (CEF/Vue): read the route and Pinia state, navigate, show/hide the UI, display a message, and drive the DOM (arbitrary JS, click, wheel, typing, keyboard, hover) for interface testing. JS commands are sent with be:executeJS; results come back to GE through window.beamng.sendEngineLua to the `_cb.vueDump` / `_cb.uiEval` callbacks.
notes: Security warning: ui_eval runs arbitrary JavaScript in the UI.

ui_eval and dump_vue_state are asynchronous: a call returns the result of the previous request (if there is one) or a "call again" message. In ui_eval, if a result is already pending it is returned WITHOUT relaunching the evaluation. The JS body can be an expression (auto-returned if the text does not contain "return").
The ui_eval serializer is bounded (depth 5, 200 array elements, 100 object keys); DOM nodes are reduced to a <tag#id.class> descriptor.
ui_click, ui_scroll, ui_type, ui_key, ui_hover are "fire-and-forget" (JS errors swallowed, no feedback on actual success): check the effect with ui_eval. `nth` is 1-based.
The ui_eval callback is shared: `ui_eval` uses shared.asyncResults.ui, `dump_vue_state` shared.asyncResults.vue.

cb.desc: Callbacks `vueDump(s)` and `uiEval(s)`: store the string in shared.asyncResults.vue / .ui.

get_ui_state.desc: UI state: route/scope (ui_router.getState) and game state (core_gamestate.getGameState).

dump_vue_state.desc: Requests a snapshot of the current route and the Pinia stores (asynchronous).

toggle_ui.desc: Shows/hides the UI (like Alt+U) via ui_visibility.

args.desc: {show?: boolean} true/false to set, absent to toggle.

show_message.desc: Displays a message in the game's message app via ui_message; reusing the same category replaces the previous message.

args.desc: {text: string, ttl?: number s (default 5), category?: string (default 'mcp'), icon?: string (default 'info')}

ui_eval.desc: Evaluates JavaScript in the UI and returns its value as JSON (asynchronous).

ui_click.desc: Simulates a full click (pointerdown, mousedown, pointerup, mouseup, click, optional dblclick) at the center of an element found by CSS selector; right click also triggers contextmenu.

args.desc: {selector: string, nth?: integer, button?: 'left'|'middle'|'right'|0|1|2, doubleClick?: boolean}

ui_scroll.desc: Sends a wheel event to an element (deltaY>0 = down; 120 by default if no delta).

args.desc: {selector: string, deltaX?: number, deltaY?: number, nth?: integer}

ui_type.desc: Types text into an input/textarea/contenteditable (sets the value then triggers input and change, v-model compatible).

args.desc: {selector: string, text: string, clear?: boolean (default true, false = append), nth?: integer}

returns.desc: true if a parameter is missing.

ui_key.desc: Sends a keyboard event to an element or to the active element.

args.desc: {key: string (e.g. 'Enter'), selector?: string, event?: 'down'|'up'|'press' (default keydown+keyup), nth?: integer}

ui_hover.desc: Simulates hovering (pointerover, mouseover, pointerenter, mouseenter, pointermove, mousemove) over an element.
